sourceDesign.provenanceNote: Pencil MCP exported qWosG, OKYtp and gGNxk at scale 2 from the current tracked design; the exported PNG digests match the corresponding repository PNGs byte-for-byte.
sourceDesign.exportCommand: Pencil MCP Export([qWosG, OKYtp, gGNxk], png, /tmp, {scale: 2})

visualBudgets.measurement: Share of perceptibly different pixels (YIQ threshold 0.1) between the live 390x844 light screen and the frame crop, aligned on the screen title (request/admin) or on the status card (status). Seeded deterministic content; structural probes in e2e/level-reviews-visual.spec.ts are independent of these budgets and never widened by them.

perScreenRationale.qWosG: Request form. Calibrated from the measured 0.2017 baseline (deterministic across repeated runs, +14% headroom for cross-renderer font rasterization). The residual is the documented, deliberate difference from the frame: labelled exact/range controls with a mode radio group instead of the inline '4.0 – 4.2 · Edit' summary, a collapsible evidence field, and the forward-only note placed before the submit action so it is read before committing.
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:pending: Pending state card vs its frame card. Calibrated from the measured 0.0251 baseline (+20% headroom, font rasterization only).
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:reviewing: Under review state card vs its frame card. Calibrated from the measured 0.0300 baseline (+17% headroom, font rasterization only).
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:approved: Approved state card vs its frame card. Calibrated from the measured 0.0585 baseline (+20% headroom, font rasterization only).
perScreenRationale.OKYtp:rejected: Rejected state card vs its frame card. Calibrated from the measured 0.0540 baseline (+20% headroom, font rasterization only).
perScreenRationale.gGNxk: Platform Admin decision. Calibrated from the measured 0.1999 baseline (+15% headroom). The residual is the documented, deliberate difference from the frame: the live screen adds the decision form (target level, note, reliability controls) and a fresh internal rating preview, and omits the frame's mock-only queue/theme toggles and recent-form statistics.
